test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Where was the 13th Hockey India senior women’s national hockey championship held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andhra Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **13th Hockey India Senior Women's National Hockey Championship 2023 event Details:**

 
 
• **Location: **Kakinada, Andhra Pradesh
 
• **Date:** February 26, 2023
 
 
 
• **Winners:**
 
 
• **Champion:** Hockey Madhya Pradesh
 
• **Final Match: **Hockey Madhya Pradesh defeated Hockey Maharashtra 5-1.
 
• **Key Players:** Diksha Tiwari (2 goals), Manmeet Kaur, Preeti Dubey, Aishwarya Chavan.
 
 
• **Player of the Match: **Pratibha Arya
 
• **Third Place: **Hockey Jharkhand
 
• **Match for Third Place: **Hockey Jharkhand defeated Hockey Haryana 2-1.
 
 
 
• **Key Players: **Roshni Dungdung, Reshma Soreng.
 
 
• Player of the Match: Albela Rani Toppo
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Individual Awards:**

 
 
• **Best Goalkeeper:** Sonal Minj (Hockey Jharkhand)
 
• **Best Defender:** Pratibha Arya (Hockey Madhya Pradesh)
 
• **Best Midfielder: **Manashri Narendra Shedage (Hockey Maharashtra)
 
• **Best Forward: **Albela Rani Toppo (Hockey Jharkhand)
